id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Luminary, welcome to Angri-La. I am the High Lama, who governs this temple.
"High Lama... Do you people of Angri-La know about {var:1}?
"Of course. We have awaited his coming since he was born in Dundrasil sixteen years ago.
"You've been waiting for {var:1}...? What do you mean?
"I will explain. Look at that banner.
"Angri-La has long been tied to Dundrasil. By custom, the princes of Dundrasil train here for six years as boys.
"{var:1}, born a prince of Dundrasil, was meant to train here under Grand Master Pang.
"Sadly, Dundrasil was destroyed by monsters and that did not come to pass...
"If fate had been different, you would have spent your childhood in this temple.
"But where is Grand Master Pang, who would have been his teacher?
"Our leader, Grand Master Pang, summoned a vast guardian mandala to shield us when Mordegon shattered the world.
"The barrier saved the temple, but the Grand Master gave his life and never returned...
"I see... Grand Master Pang sacrificed himself to protect this temple.
"In his place, there is somewhere I must show you. Please come to the Field of Discipline behind the High Hall.
"Sad about Grand Master Pang, but let's see the Field of Discipline the High Lama mentioned."
